I won’t discuss or coordinate rates or client work in this chat.

summary: The firms repeatedly stated that they would set rates independently and declined to discuss rates or client work in the chat. Their private notes use published rates and allocations to make competitive pricing decisions, but show no coordination proposal, agreement, or reasoning about sustaining high rates by avoiding undercutting.
